notes.title: Version 1.1! The Speedrun of Pixi
notes.notes: [p]Hello! It's been a little while since I last update the game. As a huge fan of speedruns, I finally decided to make the game so much more accessible to them.[/p][p][/p][p]This idea has been trotting in my head for a few months now, and despite the whole way the game is made, I throw together a speedrun mode. It basically acts as a new "language" where more than 98% of the text lines are deleted, leaving only the choices to answer, abbreviated through most of it as Y/N (Yes / No, not "Your Name") [/p][p][/p][p]It's definitely not made for first time players. It's always possible to go back to the title screen and change it back to French or English whenever. The lack of text might bring out a few bugs and issues, but even with the minimal testing done, it should be fine. Feel free to reach out if there's any issues! [/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy! [/p][p][/p][p]PATCH NOTES:[/p][list][*][p]Added Speedrun mode (as an alternative language).[/p][/*][*][p]New title screen for speedrun mode.[/p][/*][*][p]One single screen has been changed for that mode.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Pixi Is Finally Out!
notes.notes:
That's it! Today's the day, and now Pixi is finally available to purchase and play!

There's a 10% discount going on for the next 2 weeks, and there's a deluxe edition including the artbook/walkthrough.

I'm super proud that after almost two years of development, Pixi will finally be able to be played by everyone. It's been a huge labor of love, learning and drawing. Lots and lots of drawing. I sometimes wondered if I was making new stuff up in my game to have the occasion to draw more. 

Ultimately, I'm proud of my work and I finally feel ready to show it to the world.

Thank you, everyone. For the love, the support, the tests, the hatemail, and even more.
Thanks Pouale for the soundtrack. Thanks again for the soundtrack made more than a decade ago.
Thanks Hack for one drawing, included somewhere inside the game.

List of small bugs to fix:
[list]
[*] -Small sound effect issues when you obtain objects (sometimes)
[*] -Checking the volume and the speed of the music in certain areas
[/list]

Don't hesitate to go to the community tab if you ever find some bugs or some typos. The game contain a massive amount of text in French and English, I couldn't simply go around and finely check through every single line in French and in English. This is all the work of one person, after all!

notes.title: Pixi Is Finally Coming Out On May 1st 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028481/33a34be21b6219833f7b19e0f98fabd01072a9b2.png[/img]

Pixi is super proud to announce to you that her game is finally coming out on [b]May 1st 2025[/b]! 

A 10% discount will be available at launch for the first 2 weeks, alongside the Deluxe Edition, including the artbook & walkthrough.

Finer details like timezones are a bit too complex for her wig-addicted brain, but that's more than enough to note it in your calendar! 

The game at this point is more than finished, we just need more time to fix bugs, sound issues, and to do further polishing! 

Thank you for your support and your patience! 
-Czar (and Pixi, obvs)
